description: This file defines the BasketService class, which implements basket-related functionalities such as adding items, deleting a basket, setting item quantities, and transferring baskets for users in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: BasketService
classes.description: A service class providing operations related to shopping baskets, including creation, modification, deletion, and transfer between anonymous and authenticated users.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to a user's basket, creating a new basket if necessary.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes a basket identified by its ID.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Sets quantities for items in a basket based on a provided dictionary of item IDs and quantities.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers items from an anonymous basket to a user-specific basket, deleting the anonymous one afterward.
